name: Stevenson
notes: West wind only. Bob's Beach launch; flat-ish river, good warm-up for the Gorge.
parking: Bob's Beach lot off Cascade Ave, Stevenson WA

name: Hood River Sandbar
notes: West wind only. 14–25 mph typical, 25–35+ when it's on. Sandbar is managed by the Columbia Gorge Kiteboarding Assoc.
parking: Hood River Event Site / Sandbar lot (Port of Hood River, day fee)

name: Rufus (Rock Pile)
notes: East Gorge, west wind only. 12–50 mph depending on the pattern; often blowing when Hood River is light.
parking: Rufus launch, Old Hwy 30 / I-84 exit 109

name: Fort Stevens / Clatsop Spit
notes: Northernmost coast spot, big open beach. Good for downwinders; watch the Columbia bar current.
parking: Fort Stevens State Park, Parking Lot C (day-use fee or OR State Parks pass)

name: Gearhart
notes: Summer NW thermal starts ~2pm, 15–30 mph. Drive-on beach; cars on the sand are the hazard.
parking: Gearhart beach access at end of 10th St (drive on sand)

name: Manzanita / Nehalem Bay
notes: Windiest spot on the north coast; usually blows ~10 mph stronger than nearby beaches. Bring the small kite.
parking: Nehalem Bay State Park day-use lot (OR State Parks pass)

name: Rockaway Beach
notes: Long straight beach, easy access from 101. Lighter than Manzanita on the same day.
parking: Rockaway Beach wayside lot, S 1st Ave

name: Bayocean Spit
notes: Closest to the Bay City house. Ocean beach on the outside; the bay side flattens out at lower tide.
parking: Bayocean Peninsula trailhead lot, Bayocean Rd

name: Oceanside
notes: Under the cliffs, quiet. On a good swell day it's one of the best wave spots on the north coast.
parking: Oceanside Beach State Recreation Site lot, Pacific Ave

name: Cape Lookout
notes: Long beach north of the cape; the headland shelters S wind and accelerates N wind.
parking: Cape Lookout State Park day-use lot (OR State Parks pass)

name: Pacific City
notes: Cape Kiwanda bends the N wind; launch well south of the dory boats and surfers.
parking: Cape Kiwanda lot (paid) or Bob Straub State Park lot to the south

name: Roads End, Lincoln City
notes: Long stretch of beach at the north end of town, away from the crowds.
parking: Roads End State Recreation Site lot, Logan Rd

name: Newport South Jetty
notes: Some of the best down-the-line wave riding on the coast when NW wind meets NW swell.
parking: South Jetty lot, SW Jetty Way (South Beach State Park)

name: Florence South Jetty
notes: N wind: ride the south jetty. S wind (winter, gustier): ride the north jetty. Can hit 40+; go early on big days.
parking: South Jetty Rd beach lot, Oregon Dunes NRA (day fee)

name: Floras Lake
notes: Freshwater lake behind the dunes, steady N wind, waist-deep launch. Worth the drive when it's nuking everywhere else. 8–10m kites typical.
parking: Boice Cope County Park, Floras Lake Loop Rd
